scenes.narration: February first, 2009. Jeju Island. A childcare teacher boards a taxi at three AM.
scenes.image_prompt: rain-soaked Jeju street at 3 AM, taxi pulling away, empty road, monochrome noir, film grain
scenes.stock_search_query: Jeju Island empty street night taxi

scenes.narration: She calls a taxi through directory service. That is the last confirmed trace of her alive.
scenes.image_prompt: taxi dispatch phone, hand pressing numbers, dim screen glow, forensic document, monochrome

scenes.narration: The taxi arrives. She gets in. The meter activates. She never reaches home.
scenes.image_prompt: taxi interior rear seat, empty passenger view, rain streaks, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: Her family reports her missing after six days. A bag appears. Her wallet. Her phone.
scenes.image_prompt: evidence bag with wallet and phone, chain of custody, forensic table, monochrome

scenes.narration: Seven days later, a farmer finds her in a drainage ditch near Aewol. Top only.
scenes.image_prompt: empty drainage ditch, bare earth, overcast sky, forensic marker, clinical restraint

scenes.narration: The autopsy shows ligature marks on her neck. Strangulation. Upper clothing missing. Bruising from struggle.
scenes.image_prompt: medical examiner report, neck diagram, ligature mark annotation, monochrome

scenes.narration: But the pathologist estimates death within twenty-four hours of discovery. Not the day she vanished.
scenes.image_prompt: autopsy timeline graph, conflicting date arrows, coroner note, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: Police canvass five thousand taxi drivers across Jeju. The focus narrows to one man: Park.
scenes.image_prompt: taxi driver lineup, five thousand files, suspect photo with red string, monochrome

scenes.narration: Park drove a white NF Sonata. CCTV places a matching vehicle near the scene at the critical time.
scenes.image_prompt: CCTV still frame, white taxi at intersection, timestamp, red circle annotation

scenes.narration: Analysts find microfibers in Park's taxi. Similar to fur on Lee's jacket. A possible connection.
scenes.image_prompt: microscope fiber evidence, jacket texture comparison, forensic document, monochrome

scenes.narration: But the fibers are mass-produced. The court rules they cannot be uniquely linked to one vehicle.
scenes.image_prompt: fiber batch stamp, mass production chart, evidence inconsistency, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: Park deleted phone call records. Suspicious. But deletion alone does not prove murder.
scenes.image_prompt: phone call log with gaps, deletion marker, suspicious but inconclusive, monochrome

scenes.narration: A blood-stained jean is found in a motel room. The search lacked a warrant. The evidence is suppressed.
scenes.image_prompt: illegal search warrant, suppressed evidence stamp, redacted report, monochrome

scenes.narration: Prosecutors rely on circumstantial evidence. No weapon. No DNA. No eyewitness. No direct proof.
scenes.image_prompt: evidence table with empty slots, circumstantial cards, clinical restraint, monochrome

scenes.narration: The first trial begins in 2019. Ten years after the crime. The family waits. The evidence is weighed.
scenes.image_prompt: empty courtroom dock, gavel, ten-year case file, film grain, monochrome

scenes.narration: July 11th, 2019. The verdict arrives. Not guilty. The fibers are insufficient. The CCTV is inconclusive.
scenes.image_prompt: not guilty verdict headline, newspaper clipping, empty dock, film grain, monochrome

scenes.narration: Prosecutors appeal immediately. They argue the cumulative weight of evidence proves guilt.
scenes.image_prompt: appeal brief stack, cumulative evidence arrows, clinical monochrome, typewriter labels

scenes.narration: The appellate court reviews. Same evidence. Same arguments. Same conclusion. Not guilty again.
scenes.image_prompt: appellate courtroom, second not guilty stamp, film grain, monochrome

scenes.narration: July 8th, 2020. The appellate court reaffirms acquittal. Circumstantial evidence cannot exclude reasonable doubt.
scenes.image_prompt: appellate verdict document, reasonable doubt highlight, monochrome documentary

scenes.narration: Prosecutors escalate to the Supreme Court. They challenge the lower courts' standard of proof.
scenes.image_prompt: Supreme Court building, legal brief, standard of proof question, dark monochrome

scenes.narration: October 28th, 2021. The Supreme Court confirms acquittal. Mass-produced fibers cannot single out one suspect.
scenes.image_prompt: Supreme Court confirmation stamp, mass-produced fibers document, case unresolved, monochrome

scenes.narration: The murder statute of limitations expired. The 2015 abolition came too late for Lee's case.
scenes.image_prompt: statute expiration clock, 2015 abolition key unused, time-bound justice, monochrome

scenes.narration: Park had relocated to North Gyeongsang. He lived there for nine years before rearrest. The sources say he moved between various regions. Not an assumed name. Just displacement.
scenes.image_prompt: relocation map, assumed identity document, nine-year gap, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: After acquittal, Park speaks. His life is destroyed. His defense team claimed he never met Lee. Park himself said his life was ruined and the system treated him like a shackle.
scenes.image_prompt: Park silhouette, microphone, destroyed life quote, film grain, monochrome

scenes.narration: The family receives no closure. No conviction. No apology. Just a legal system that reached no answer.
scenes.image_prompt: family portrait, empty justice scales, Supreme Court document, dark moody, monochrome

scenes.narration: In 2015, South Korea abolished the murder statute. Cold case families gained hope.
scenes.image_prompt: TAWAN Act document, statute clock reset, hope and family portrait, monochrome

scenes.narration: Jeju police form a cold case team in 2016. They re-examine the body. The taxi. The timeline.
scenes.image_prompt: cold case team meeting, evidence board, re-examination markers, monochrome

scenes.narration: The timeline remains contested. The autopsy says death within twenty-four hours of discovery. Police say February first.
scenes.image_prompt: conflicting timeline chart, autopsy versus police arrows, contradiction, monochrome

scenes.narration: To resolve the timeline, scientists run decomposition experiments. Pigs and dogs. Controlled conditions.
scenes.image_prompt: decomposition experiment, pig and dog specimens, forensic scientists, clinical restraint

scenes.narration: The results suggest death closer to February first. But animal-to-human extrapolation is not proof.
scenes.image_prompt: decomposition timeline, animal to human arrow, uncertainty margin, scientific diagram

scenes.narration: Police arrest Park in May 2018. Nine years after the crime. They believe evidence now supports prosecution.
scenes.image_prompt: arrest warrant, police car lights, nine-year gap closed, monochrome noir

scenes.narration: The trial begins March 2019. Park's defense denies everything. No meeting. No crime. No evidence.
scenes.image_prompt: defense table, Park silhouette, denial, empty prosecution table, monochrome

scenes.narration: Prosecutors present target fiber analysis. The defense calls it imprecise. Mass production undermines uniqueness.
scenes.image_prompt: target fiber report, mass production stamp, defense objection, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: CCTV shows a white Sonata. Eighteen such taxis operated on Jeju. Probability is not identity.
scenes.image_prompt: eighteen Sonata grid, CCTV highlight, probability not identity, diagram style

scenes.narration: The deleted phone records suggest cover-up. The defense says routine data management. The court notes suspicion.
scenes.image_prompt: deleted call records, routine management argument, suspicious, monochrome

scenes.narration: No murder weapon is found. No DNA connects Park. The fibers are not unique. The CCTV is probabilistic.
scenes.image_prompt: empty evidence table, missing weapon, no DNA match, uncertain CCTV, monochrome

scenes.narration: The first verdict: not guilty. Reasonable doubt cannot be excluded. Circumstantial evidence is not proof.
scenes.image_prompt: verdict document, reasonable doubt highlighted, inference not proof, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: Prosecutors appeal. They argue cumulative weight makes the case. The court disagrees. Each piece remains insufficient.
scenes.image_prompt: appeal brief, cumulative evidence chart, insufficient verdict, monochrome

scenes.narration: July 2020. Second not guilty. The appellate court finds the prosecution's forensic claims below the proof standard.
scenes.image_prompt: second appeal verdict, proof standard bar, evidence falling short, monochrome

scenes.narration: The prosecution goes to the Supreme Court. They claim lower courts misapplied the standard. Cumulative impact ignored.
scenes.image_prompt: Supreme Court brief, cumulative impact diagram, reversal request, dark monochrome

scenes.narration: October 2021. The Supreme Court dismisses the appeal. Mass-produced fibers cannot distinguish one taxi from another.
scenes.image_prompt: Supreme Court dismissal, fiber exclusion logic, case closed legally, monochrome

scenes.narration: Park's acquittal is final. Double jeopardy prevents retrial. The state's chance to prove guilt is exhausted.
scenes.image_prompt: double jeopardy wall, final acquittal seal, closed courthouse, monochrome

scenes.narration: But legally final is not factually resolved. The questions remain. Who picked Lee up that night?
scenes.image_prompt: unanswered question mark, empty taxi, foggy road, unresolved file, monochrome

scenes.narration: Another taxi driver reported picking up a woman matching Lee. This lead was deprioritized.
scenes.image_prompt: second taxi driver silhouette, witness report, deprioritized lead, dark mystery, monochrome

scenes.narration: The Supreme Court explicitly noted the second taxi possibility. Reasonable doubt. The victim may have boarded a third vehicle.
scenes.image_prompt: Supreme Court excerpt, third taxi highlighted, reasonable doubt, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: If the second driver is truthful, Lee was alive after leaving Park's taxi. Everything shifts.
scenes.image_prompt: timeline branching diagram, two taxi routes, murder location uncertainty, scientific diagram

scenes.narration: The second taxi driver's identity is protected. His vehicle was never examined. His route was never verified.
scenes.image_prompt: anonymous witness file, untested vehicle icon, unverified route, dark mystery, monochrome

scenes.narration: Why was this lead deprioritized? The investigation fixated on Park early. Confirmation bias shaped every step.
scenes.image_prompt: confirmation bias diagram, spotlight on Park, second taxi in shadow, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: Five thousand drivers canvassed. Breadth without depth is theatre. The second taxi was never located.
scenes.image_prompt: five thousand canvass map, empty second taxi slot, theatrical spotlight, monochrome

scenes.narration: The decomposition experiment used pigs and dogs. Defense argued species differences. Translation to human is speculative.
scenes.image_prompt: pig dog decomposition chart, species difference warning, extrapolation arrow, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: Target fiber analysis was groundbreaking. But groundbreaking is not infallible. The court demanded higher standards.
scenes.image_prompt: target fiber lab, innovation versus validation scale, microscope, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: Eighteen white Sonata taxis operated on Jeju. CCTV could not isolate Park's specific vehicle. Probability is not identity.
scenes.image_prompt: eighteen Sonata grid, CCTV highlight, probability not identity, diagram style

scenes.narration: Park's deleted records were suspicious. Innocent people delete data too. Suspicion is not proof.
scenes.image_prompt: deleted call log, innocent versus guilty Venn, reasonable doubt scale, monochrome

scenes.narration: Park left Jeju after the first investigation. He lived elsewhere for nine years. The case went cold.
scenes.image_prompt: relocation path, stalled investigation sign, nine-year gap, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: The cold case team formed in 2016. They re-examined everything. New tests. New evidence. Not new proof.
scenes.image_prompt: cold case team, re-examination markers, new evidence not proof, documentary

scenes.narration: The decomposition experiment shifted the timeline toward February first. But it did not close the case.
scenes.image_prompt: experiment result chart, needle moving, court record original estimate, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: The Supreme Court's reasoning is narrow. Mass-produced fibers exclude other taxis. Reasonable doubt remains.
scenes.image_prompt: Supreme Court flowchart, fiber exclusion logic, doubt shield, clinical monochrome

scenes.narration: Double jeopardy blocks retrial. Even if new evidence emerges. Even if the second driver is found.
scenes.image_prompt: double jeopardy wall, retrial blocked sign, new evidence barrier, monochrome

scenes.narration: Lee was twenty-six. A childcare teacher. A daughter. She took a taxi home. That is certain.
scenes.image_prompt: young woman portrait, childcare teacher, certain fact, taxi home route, monochrome

scenes.narration: The investigation expended man-years. Forensic science. Court proceedings. The outcome was not what anyone wanted.
scenes.image_prompt: investigation resources, man-years clock, forensic tools, unsatisfying outcome, monochrome

scenes.narration: Park's life after acquittal is private. No media. No advocacy. Just a man destroyed by accusation.
scenes.image_prompt: solitary figure, no microphone, aftermath landscape, dark moody, monochrome

scenes.narration: The family's grief is ongoing. No resolution changes February first, 2009. A daughter gone.
scenes.image_prompt: family grief, February first calendar, wrong answer stamp, ongoing sorrow, monochrome
